benchmark_type_evidence: we introduce AFROBENCH—a multi-task benchmark for evaluating the performance of LLMs across 64 African languages, 15 tasks and 22 datasets... Finally, we created a new evaluation dataset, AFRIADR, a dataset for restoring diacritic marks and tonal accents in African language texts.
brief_description: AfroBench is a comprehensive multi-task benchmark for evaluating LLM performance across 64 African languages, comprising 15 NLP tasks and 22 datasets spanning NLU, text generation, QA, and reasoning. It aggregates existing African language evaluation datasets and introduces one new dataset (AfriADR) for diacritics restoration.
